identityDecision: Use the named Hunn stone-ring archaeological site as the stable visitor and interpretation anchor for the larger multi-part Hunn burial landscape.

fieldScope.finding: Hunn is a large and well-preserved burial field with more than 100 mounds, cairns and stone circles, usually divided into Vestfeltet, Sydfeltet and Midtfeltet.

crossChecks.finding: The stone-ring field is the clearest public destination at Hunn and contains rings, smaller graves, cairns and other traces spread across a larger area.
Archaeological investigations in 1950–1952 examined 31 monuments and explicitly treated the remains as a complete Iron Age farm and landscape context.
Askeladden-derived documentation identifies the protected stone-ring field; nearby rock art locality 151039 is a separate monument east of the field.
